findings.title: Prompt injection causes unauthorized tool execution
findings.description: A malicious support ticket induces an unauthorized refund that the backend executes.
reasons: Authorization bypass and unauthorized action independently recorded

findings.title: Unauthorized cross-user refund
findings.description: A user can trigger a refund for another customer's order.
reasons: Authorization bypass and unauthorized action independently recorded

findings.title: Tainted order ID with effective authorization
findings.description: User-controlled order ID reaches a refund function, but ownership and approval checks block unauthorized execution.
reasons: Verified control blocked the unauthorized operation

findings.title: Prompt injection blocked by secure executor
findings.description: The model requests an unauthorized refund, but the backend rejects it.
reasons: Verified control blocked the unauthorized operation

findings.title: Possible document authorization bypass
findings.description: Static analysis found a document retrieval path without a recognizable ownership guard. Exploitability has not been verified.

findings.title: Possible excessive-agency vulnerability
findings.description: An agent has access to a sensitive administrative tool, but the tool's effective permissions have not been tested.

findings.title: Malformed tool arguments rejected
findings.description: An LLM supplies unauthorized tool arguments, and the executor rejects them.
reasons: Verified control blocked the unauthorized operation
